question: Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded a reform association known as Brahmo Sabha which was later known as ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Brahmo Samaj**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The Brahmo Samaj was established in 1828 by Raja Ram Mohan Roy. 
 
• The movement began between meetings of Bengalis in Calcutta in 1828.
 
• The conflict between Keshab Chandra Sen and Debendranath Tagore was broadened in 1865 when Tagore allowed the Brahmos conducting services to wear their sacred threads. 
 
• Keshab objected to this decision and withdrew from the Brahmo Samaj along with his followers.
 
• He established the Brahmo Samaj of India on 15th November 1866.
 
• While on the other hand, Tagore grouped themselves in Adi Brahmo Samaj.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The main agenda of the Brahmo Samaj is to purify Hinduism and teach monotheism.
 
• The ideals of Brahmo samaj relied on the twin pillars of reason and Vedas and Upanishads.
